canonical_source.author: Pallavi Raonka
canonical_source.title: Munda Politics and Land: Understanding Indigeneity in Jharkhand, India

scope.methods_reported_in_repository_abstract: fifteen-month ethnographic study, May 2017 to December 2018, using several forms of qualitative data
scope.scope_classification: direct Munda-community ethnography/politics; potentially high-value primary-research source

deduplication.rule: Treat repository landing page, handle resolver, dissertation PDF, citation exports and mirrors of this dissertation as manifestations of one work unless evidence establishes a distinct version. Do not count the abstract and dissertation as independent corroboration.

rights_access_consent_cultural_uncertain.repository_access: repository landing page exposes a downloadable dissertation PDF
rights_access_consent_cultural_uncertain.participant_consent_reuse: not established from repository metadata; inspect dissertation ethics/methods before participant-derived evidence promotion
rights_access_consent_cultural_uncertain.sensitive_content_policy: Do not promote restricted, sacred, private, participant-identifying or otherwise culturally sensitive material without explicit support and appropriate permission.
rights_access_consent_cultural_uncertain.representation_note: Prefer author/community-grounded descriptions and preserve uncertainty; do not generalize study-site findings to all Munda communities.

evidence_promotion.reason: Repository metadata verifies identity and broad study scope but is insufficient for proposition-level cultural claims. Exact dissertation passage locators, immutable capture/SHA-256, pagination concordance, methods/ethics review, dependency review, and rights/cultural-access checks are required before promotion.

conversion_queue: Obtain the repository-provided dissertation PDF under permitted access.
Record immutable manifestation metadata and SHA-256.
Reconcile PDF page numbers with printed dissertation pagination.
Inspect front matter, methods/ethics, consent/anonymization and field-site description before extracting participant-derived material.
Create exact page/section/quotation-span locators only for supported non-restricted propositions.
Tag author claims versus participant statements versus cited historical/secondary claims and preserve dependency edges.
